description: This file defines an interface named RouteParserInterface within the Slim Framework, specifying methods for generating URLs for named routes, including relative and full URLs, with support for route arguments and query parameters.

classes.name: RouteParserInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for constructing URLs for named routes, including relative URLs, absolute URLs, and URLs with full qualification, based on route names and parameters.

methods.name: relativeUrlFor
methods.description: Builds the path for a named route excluding the base path, with parameters for route name, data arguments, and query parameters.

methods.name: urlFor
methods.description: Builds the path for a named route including the base path, with parameters for route name, data arguments, and query parameters.

methods.name: fullUrlFor
methods.description: Generates a fully qualified URL for a named route using a base URI, route name, data arguments, and query parameters.
